messages:
Alex: Heads-up — preflight sherpa check for tomorrow's quiet window. I want a short rollcall + owners for pins/rollbacks.
Ben: 👍 I can own rollback for the API surface. Will be on-call during the window.
Jamie: Taking DB schema and migration guard. I'll unpin if migration latency > 1s across canaries.
Maria: I've got release notes + postmortem checklist updates. Can someone confirm final changelog link?
Alex: changelog is at https://go/release/2026-03-22. Maria, add the embed-cost blurb.
Kevin: I'll watch consumer-facing metrics and toggle feature flags. Rollback plan: `kubectl set image deployment/frontend frontend:vX -> frontend:vX-1` if errors > 5% for 3 minutes.
Ben: Added to doc: rollback owner = Ben, contact = @ben (pager).
Jamie: Migration guard: `ALTER TABLE ..` runs in canary-only mode for 20m, then ramp. If >1.5x p95, abort.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for release/2026-03-22-quiet. Canary ID: cb-778. Routing to 2% traffic.
oncall-bot: Reminder: change window 03/22 02:00-04:00 UTC. Silent channel = #release-war-room. Escalation policy temp -> SRE lead -> Eng EM.
Maria: Added changelog link to release doc and pinned to the top. Also attached the one-liner notes for comms.
Alex: Quick check: who can immediately unpin if a late hotfix is required? we need an approver list.
Kevin: Approver list: Alex, Ben, Jamie. I'll do immediate flags rollback if metric alarm triggers.
Ben: Confirming I can perform emergency unpin and rollback.
Jamie: I'll be nearby for DB rollback steps — flagging the exact steps in the doc now.
Alex: Perfect. Two last items: smoke scripts and deploybot SLOs. Ben/Jamie, can you run smoke script `scripts/smoke_basic.sh` post-canary and reply here with pass/fail?
Ben: Running after canary warms, will post result.
Maria: Packaging release notes and comms draft now. Will DM product for signoff.
deploy-bot: Canary cb-778 passed health checks (latency p95 within expected). Auto-scaling warmup complete.
Ben: smoke_basic.sh -> PASS. No 5xx observed for 10m. :thumbsup:
Alex: OK great. If anything degrades during the 2-4% ramp we'll hold at canary and escalate.
oncall-bot: Escalation channel set to #oncall-sre if threshold breach.
Kevin: Setting dashboard alerts to strict mode. Thresholds copied to the release doc.
Alex: Thanks everyone. Final note: if anyone needs to pull the emergency rope, post `EMERGENCY-ROLLBACK` in this thread and Ben will execute. Keep comms tight. :lock:
Maria: Comm draft queued, will post external note after green.
Ben: Acknowledged. Standing by.
